[CR CR0758 for 38.213] Reason for change: Issue 1.A :The agreement reached in RAN1#119 has not been incorporated into the current 213 (V19.1.0). This modification is necessary because the Rel-19 Type-I SP codebook exhibits significant overhead variation across different measured ranks. Specifically, RANK 7/8 yields the maximum overhead for Scheme-A, whereas RANK 4 for Scheme-B. However, according to the current spec, UE shall determine PUCCH resources under the assumption of feedback rank 1 for each CSI report. This approach is based on observations that the Rel-15 Type-I codebook maintains consistent overhead across ranks. Persisting with rank 1 assumption for Rel-19 Type-I codebook CSI reports will inevitably increase the frequency of UCI dropping incidents. Summary of change: Change the
